new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors Announces Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results – Record Revenue of $1.87B and 42% EBITDA Growth
new_today_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported Q3 2026 revenues of $1.87 billion (up 21% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of $456.1 million (up 42% YoY), with a record adjusted EBITDA margin of 24.4%. The Environmental Services segment delivered 18 consecutive quarters of year-over-year margin expansion, driven by emergency response work, PFAS-related activities, strong waste collections, and pricing initiatives. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance.

new_today_news.headline: GFL Environmental to Release Q3 2026 Earnings Results After Market Close
new_today_news.summary: GFL Environmental announced it will release third quarter 2026 financial results after market close on October 28, 2026, and host an investor conference call on October 29, 2026 at 8:30 AM Eastern Time. This follows strong Q1 and Q2 2026 performance where the company raised full-year guidance and completed 8 acquisitions generating $425-450 million in annualized revenue.

new_today_news.headline: Minnesota restaurant openings & closings for October 2026
new_today_news.source: Yahoo Finance / Bring Me The News
new_today_news.summary: Minnesota continues to see significant restaurant activity with chains like 7 Brew, Dave's Hot Chicken, and Shake Shack expanding their presence. The Twin Cities welcomed new independent coffee shops and restaurants in October, with fast-growing national chains establishing additional locations.

new_today_news.headline: Only 205,000 CDL holders are left in Wisconsin after a steady drop over the last 15 years
new_today_news.summary: Wisconsin has lost nearly 10% of its truck drivers since 2010, with CDL holders declining from 224,860 in 2010 to 204,766 by 2025. The decline occurs as transportation demand in the state rises, creating staffing pressures for waste haulers.

recent_news.headline: BC Partners Negotiates GFL Environmental Buyout as Stock Stabilizes
recent_news.summary: BC Partners is negotiating to roll its 22% minority stake in GFL Environmental into a full buyout of the waste-management company. The potential deal is rumored to be priced in the mid-$50s per share, with competing bids from KKR and Brookfield Asset Management.

recent_news.headline: Lansing Has Said Goodbye to These Restaurants in 2026
recent_news.summary: Lansing's restaurant scene experienced notable closures in 2026, including La Cocina Cubana (temporarily closed in October) and Make It Sweet bakery (closing October 31). Despite more openings than closings overall, the city has lost several long-standing favorites.

recent_news.headline: $120M Utah Wastewater Expansion Targets Rapid Growth, Capacity Crunch
recent_news.summary: Eagle Mountain, Utah, broke ground on a $120 million wastewater treatment plant expansion on Oct. 23, adding a 6-million-gallon-per-day membrane bioreactor facility. The existing plant reached its loading limit at 1.5 MGD despite 2.4 MGD hydraulic capacity, driven by concentrated sewage from new low-flow fixtures.

recent_news.headline: Thousands of American restaurants closing over rising costs, declining sales
recent_news.summary: More than 7,500 restaurant locations closed nationwide in the first six months of 2026, driven by rising costs and declining sales. The trend reflects broader economic pressures forcing restaurants to make difficult operational decisions.

recent_news.headline: This Week In Food: Deep Fall
recent_news.summary: San Francisco's dining scene includes expansions and new openings: El Buen Comer is expanding to Chase Center, and a new chicken restaurant is preparing for a soft opening on October 29. Multiple venues are opening and relocating across the city.

recent_news.headline: Global Grease Trap Cleaning Service Market Valued at $4.2 Billion in 2025
recent_news.summary: Market analysis indicating the global grease trap cleaning service market reached $4.2 billion in 2025, demonstrating the substantial industry footprint and increasing importance of professional wastewater management for food establishments. Commercial kitchens face strict municipal regulations requiring routine grease management to avoid operational shutdowns and financial penalties.

recent_news.headline: Survey Shows Restaurant Worker Sentiment on the Rise
recent_news.summary: The 2026 Voice of the Restaurant Employee Survey shows improving sentiment in foodservice, with 67% of employees satisfied with pay (up 12 percentage points year-over-year) and 62% satisfied with benefits (up 16 points). Tips are also trending upward.
